D.t: Summer Lee leads by 38.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 136,170 votes; a one point swing is about 1,774 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +30.9 and D +45.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.7M cash against $2K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
